d:
Actor Sharad Kapoor has received support from Bollywood after appealing publicly for work and help. Sonu Sood met him in Mumbai and arranged medical supplies, while Amitabh Bachchan and Salman Khan also reached out to check on him. Sharad's emotional videos, including one showing him parting with his four pet dogs, recently went viral. Recovering from a serious leg injury, he hopes to return to acting in January 2027. Will this support open new opportunities for his comeback?
